The paper repeatedly labels centroid movement as an entropy notion—e.g., "serves as a training entropy proxy" and "Mt is the global centroid movement (entropy proxy)"—but provides no derivation, theorem, or empirical validation linking Eq. (7) to entropy or information-theoretic uncertainty. The text only defines movement magnitude and uses it as a threshold trigger.

The paper repeatedly uses the term 'entropy proxy' (e.g., in Section 2.4: 'where Mt is the global centroid movement (entropy proxy) at epoch t'), but provides no mathematical definition or formal connection to information-theoretic entropy.
